jobs.description: Company DescriptionAbout us:Passion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital.Today technology is driving the world. And at METRO.digital we are driving the technology for one of the leading international wholesalers specializing in food - METRO. From e-commerce to checkout, to delivery software, we work on a wide range of products to make each day a success for our customers and colleagues. With passion and ownership, we build the future of wholesale.You are driving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? To achieve this goal, METRO decided to use the Adobe Experience Platform, one of the market leaders for digital communication tools. In the case of external solutions, this is subject to the condition that employees are given access to relevant information and training;- Advise on solution roadmap and upgrade paths;- Help optimize performance, scalability, and reliability of the deployed solution via continuous improvements;- Coordinate across squads, is SPOC for countries and leads harmonization of solution- Support with problem analysis;- Provides consultancy on solution for overarching projects and initiatives.QualificationsRequired key competencies and qualifications:- Proven expertise and relevant work experience as application or solution expert in a tech setup (multinational or startup);- Good analytical skills - you know how to ask the right questions and how to summarize everything in one picture;- Having the ability to turn complex concepts into simple language and vice versa;- Experience in managing stakeholders relations, preparing and conducting presentations and briefing your teams (Dev, Support, QA);- Being able to manage and facilitate communication in a challenging, complex and international work environment;- Mastering strategic business process modeling, traceability, linking of dependent tasks, and quality management techniques;- Very good fluency in English (written and verbal).Additional InformationWhat we offer at METRO.digital?- Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment.At METRO.digital, we promote work-life balance through a hybrid working model. You’ll be part of self-organizing, multicultural teams that collaborate in an agile setup.- People development: when you grow so do we!We want you to become the best version of yourself with individual and company-wide programs and trainings for people development. Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation ... it´s time to upskill your career.- Support with individual solutions: we are people-caring!We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey.Want to know more about all our benefits? Discover more here (https://metro.digital/about/life-at-metro) .Let´s connect soon. Apply for the role now!Position grade within our career framework: Solution Expert (Md5).

jobs.occupation: Product Line Manager/Engineer (f/m/d) – Laser Diodes (Ingenieur/in - Photonik, Optotechnologien)
jobs.description: Your mission Product Line Manager/Engineer (f/m/d) – Laser DiodesTake ownership of our laser diodes – from materials to customersLocation: Dortmund, GermanyEmployment type: Full-time (40 hours/week)Salary: EUR 50,000–65,000 gross per yearIf you enjoy understanding a product down to the smallest detail and following issues through to resolution, we look forward to getting to know you.• Ownership of an assigned product line and a detailed understanding of its materials, components, specifications, performance and applications• Planning, coordination and execution of product qualification and reliability testing, including evaluation of results and preparation of qualification reports• Analysis of measurement and production data to assess product performance, investigate deviations and support improvements• Coordination of the initial release of new materials and products into production• Creation and maintenance of technical product documentation, including specifications, bills of materials (BOMs), bills of process (BOPs) and release records• Creation and maintenance of part numbers as well as product and material master data, ensuring accuracy, consistency and traceability• Maintenance of product line information, including material classifications and product variants• Cross-departmental coordination of technical product changes, ensuring complete and up-to-date documentation and product information• Gradual takeover of technical support for our Sales team and customers, including clarifying requirements and preparing product data and analysesYour profile• Technical background in photonics, gained through education or relevant professional experience• Familiarity with semiconductor lasers, optoelectronic components or related photonic products• Experience in product characterisation, qualification, reliability testing or measurement data analysis• Confident use of appropriate analytical tools to evaluate measurement and production data• Strong attention to detail and a genuine interest in how every material, component and process step affects the final product• A strong sense of ownership and the drive to investigate discrepancies thoroughly and follow issues through to resolution• Careful handling of technical documentation and data• Independent, systematic working style and effective coordination across departments• Ability to explain technical findings clearly to colleagues and customers• Fluent German and English, both written and spokenNice to Have• Experience in product line management, product engineering, qualification or a similar technical role• Experience with MES/ERP systemsWhy us?For our site in Dortmund, we are looking for a photonics professional to join us as Product Line Manager/Engineer (f/m/d). You will take ownership of your own product line throughout its entire lifecycle – from qualification and reliability testing to technical documentation and customer support.Innolume was among the first companies to successfully commercialize quantum-dot semiconductor devices. With our two in-house MBE reactors and our expertise in quantum-well and quantum-dot laser technology, we are at the forefront of photonics innovation. As we move towards volume production, this role offers the rare opportunity to understand a high-tech product in every detail and shape it throughout its entire lifecycle.What We Offer• Real product ownership with a direct impact on the quality and success of our laser diodes• A structured onboarding and the opportunity to expand your area of responsibility step by step• An international, multicultural team with flat hierarchies• Short decision-making paths and close collaboration across departments• Individual training and continuous learning opportunities• Flexible working hours and 30 days of annual leave• From the 7th month of employment, additional benefitsJoin InnolumeHelp us bring the next generation of laser diodes to volume production. Send us your application, including your earliest possible start date and notice period, to jobs@innolume.com.We look forward to receiving your application.About usInnolume is an internationally operating specialist for laser diodes based on InGaAs/GaAs quantum-well and quantum-dot technologies. As part of our team, you will work on innovative projects for customers all over the world.Our team of experts is always there to help you learn and develop your skills. We offer plenty of opportunities and room for personal and professional growth.We believe in a motivating and supportive work environment, and we take great care to create one. A family-like work culture and regular team events are central to this.Whether you are new to the field or an experienced professional: we are always looking for new talent to train and welcome into our team of experts. We offer full-time positions as well as a range of internships.

jobs.occupation: Senior Crisis Management Specialist (f/m/d) (Chief Operating Officer)
jobs.description: You have a passion for technology and want to help shape the future of energy?Then become a playmaker and join our team at E.ON Digital Technology.​We play a key role in shaping the energy transition by leading E.ON's digital transformation across Europe. We explore new paths by developing ideas, breaking new ground, making visions reality, and bringing new technologies to life. We deliver digital solutions for a changing energy landscape because…​… it’s on us to make new energy work!The Team – your impactYou are a member of the Crisis Management und Physical Security Coordination team. Together with your colleagues, you develop and operate E.ON’s Group-wide crisis management organisation, helping to safeguard security of supply and protect people, critical infrastructure and assets across the E.ON Group.As part of a strong network of Crisis Management professionals across E.ON’s German and European business units, you initiate and jointly drive Group-wide topics, foster collaboration and continuously strengthen E.ON’s crisis preparedness and response capabilities. Your Role – meaningful und rewarding- Develop and continuously improve E.ON’s Group-wide crisis management framework, standards and processes together with Crisis Management leads and experts across the business units - Initiate and jointly drive Group-wide Crisis Management topics, fostering collaboration, alignment and knowledge sharing across E.ON’s German and European businesses - Lead crisis preparedness activities, including crisis plans, playbooks, exercises, training and lessons-learned processes  - Coordinate and support E.ON’s crisis management organization during major incidents, including activation, situation reporting and escalation processes - Provide structured decision support to E.ON’s crisis management team and senior management through situation assessments, scenario analysis, options and recommendations during crises- Continuously monitor and assess relevant threats and emerging risks and translate them into actionable situation reports, executive briefings and recommendations - Monitor relevant regulatory requirements, industry developments and best practices and translate them into practical improvements to E.ON’s crisis management capabilities- Coordinate and maintain key interfaces with authorities, emergency services, industry associations and other external crisis partners - Collaborate closely with Business Continuity, Physical Security, Communications, IT, OT and other key functions to strengthen E.ON’s crisis preparedness and organizational resilience  Your Profile – authentic und open-minded- Extensive professional experience in Crisis Management within a corporate, critical infrastructure or similarly complex operational environment - Proven experience in developing and operating crisis management frameworks and in supporting or managing crisis response  - Strong understanding of crisis management, emergency preparedness, critical infrastructure protection and organisational resilience, including relevant standards such as ISO 22361 and ISO 22301 - Experience working with senior management and external crisis partners such as authorities, emergency services and industry organisations; experience with crisis management tools, alerting systems and structured situation reporting is an advantage - Good understanding of the interdependencies between business operations, physical infrastructure and IT/OT environments, ideally within the energy or critical infrastructure sector - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex situations and translate them into clear recommendations under pressure - Strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills, with proven experience working collaboratively across functions, business units and countries - Strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach, sound judgement and a strong sense of ownership - Relevant professional certifications or qualifications in Crisis Management, Business Continuity or related disciplines are an advantage - Business fluency in English and German, both written and spoken  Our Benefits – smart und useful​- Recharge your battery: You have 30 days of paid vacation per year plus Christmas and New Yearund#39;s Eve off. Your battery still needs charging? You can exchange parts of your salary for more paid vacation or you can take a sabbatical.​- Advance your development: We grow and we want you to grow with us. Learning on the job, exchanging with others, or taking part in an individual training – our learning culture enables you to bring your personal and professional development to the next level.​- Enjoy hybrid work: We combine office collaboration with focused work from home. It’s also possible to go on workation for up to 20 days per year within Europe.​​- Stay active und healthy: Benefit from a company-sponsored health membership.​- Elevate your mobility: From car and bike leasing offers to a subsidised Deutschland-Ticket – your way is our way.​- Think ahead: With our company pension scheme and a great insurance package we take care of your future.​- This is by far not all… We are looking forward to speaking with you about further benefits during the hiring process.

template and the needs of productive operations.- Ensure requirements are sufficiently clear, approved and traceable, and that legal effective dates and business deadlines are translated into realistic delivery plans.- Coordinate impact assessments across SAP Finance, SAP Ariba where relevant, master data, reporting, authorizations, interfaces and non-SAP partner systems.- Protect productive operations by ensuring controlled releases, appropriate regression testing, cutover planning, support readiness and post-go-live monitoring.Functional and technical coordination- Use prior functional consultants, developers, integration teams, test teams, release management, AMS, country organizations and external partners.- Identify interdependencies across processes, systems, communication.- Act as the central project contact for country Finance stakeholders, LUCA teams, METRO Digital, the System Integrator and other delivery partners.- Build trust across cultures and time About AtariAtari is an interactive entertainment company and an iconic gaming industry brand recognized worldwide for its multi-platform games and licensed products. Atari owns and/or manages a portfolio of more than 400 games and franchises, including globally recognized brands such as Asteroids®, Centipede®, Missile Command®, Pong®, and RollerCoaster Tycoon®.The Atari family of brands includes Digital Eclipse, Nightdive Studios, Infogrames, AtariAge, MobyGames, as well as Hipster Whale, Coatsink, Early Morning Studios, and Stormteller Games—spanning game development, publishing, and community experiences worldwide.Atari operates internationally with offices in the US, UK, in France, Germany, Sweden, and India.About the roleMünster, Germany · Part-timeThe Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator will provide executive, administrative and project coordination support to the CFO. Based in Germany and working closely with the CFO in France, you will help keep financial administration, corporate governance and cross-border operational matters moving to completion.This is a practical coordination role for someone who is organised, persistent and comfortable following up with banks, lawyers, tax advisers, notaries, corporate service providers and internal teams. You will coordinate documents, signatures, banking administration, KYC and AML requests, legal entity changes and board formalities across the Atari Group.You do not need to be an accountant or a technical finance specialist. You do need to be reliable with sensitive information, comfortable with formal processes and willing to chase the right people until an item is complete.What you’ll do- Provide day-to-day executive and administrative support to the CFO, coordinating priorities across Germany, France and the US.- Coordinate the preparation, circulation, approval and execution of corporate documents, board resolutions, powers of attorney and other legal or finance documentation.- Manage signature workflows, monitor outstanding actions and ensure documents are signed, returned and stored on time.- Coordinate banking administration, including account openings and closures, bank mandates, signatory updates and KYC/AML requests.- Maintain accurate corporate records and legal entity documentation, ensuring information is complete, current and easy to retrieve.- Support legal entity shutdowns, entity administration and related projects by coordinating actions across Finance, Legal, tax advisers, banks and external service providers.- Liaise with banks, external legal counsel, tax lawyers, corporate service providers, notaries and local finance teams on administrative and corporate matters.- Coordinate board minutes, governance records, approvals, formalities and other recurring corporate requirements.- Support finance-related administrative work, including gathering information, tracking deadlines, maintaining records and coordinating deliverables.- Act as a project coordinator for cross-functional finance and governance workstreams, keeping owners aligned and following through on open items.- Provide administrative support for certain Luxembourg-related matters and coordinate with the relevant internal and external contacts.- Escalate delays, missing information, unclear ownership or material issues to the CFO or relevant functional lead.Requirements & Qualifications- Professional fluency in English, with the ability to communicate clearly in writing and verbally with internal and external stakeholders.- Experience in an administrative, executive support, banking, legal operations, paralegal, corporate services or similar coordination role.- Strong organisation and follow-through, with the confidence to chase people, manage deadlines and keep multiple workstreams moving.- Experience handling confidential information and formal documentation with accuracy and discretion.- Comfort working with banks, lawyers, advisers, notaries, corporate service providers or other external stakeholders.- Ability to work independently, prioritise changing requests and operate with flexibility when the CFO and key stakeholders are based in another country.- Good judgement and attention to detail when coordinating governance, KYC/AML, banking and legal entity administration.Nice to have- Professional proficiency in French.- Experience supporting a CFO, finance leader, executive team or European corporate function.- Experience in a bank, financial institution, law office, corporate services provider or multinational business.- Familiarity with KYC/AML processes, bank mandates, signatory administration, powers of attorney, board documentation or legal entity management.- Experience coordinating entity closures, corporate reorganisations, acquisitions or other cross-border projects.- Familiarity with Luxembourg corporate or finance administration.How you’ll workThis role is about making sure important administrative and governance work does not sit unresolved. You will often be coordinating several parties at once, clarifying what is needed, tracking who owns the next step and following up until the document, approval, bank request or entity action is complete.You will work closely with Finance and Legal, but you are not expected to provide accounting or legal advice.
